findings.claim: helperCustody.env appends the custody word without removing an inherited METASYSTEM_FIXTURE_OWNER word, unlike testutil.ProcessFixture.Env, so under an outer fixture word the environment-carried helpers would be tagged with the outer key.
findings.evidence: internal/testutil/fixture.go:169-174 deletes prior FixtureOwnerEnv entries; testenv's rejectsInheritedControl covers FixtureCustodianEnv but not FixtureOwnerEnv; identity.FixtureTag returns the first parseable environment word. Affected sites: newOwnedHeldProcess (arming_test.go:82), the raw watcher (:1420), the raw owner-shaped helper (:1937). Owners and components carry an argument word, read first, and are unaffected. No runner of this package is known to set the word (inferred).
findings.change: Strip prior FixtureOwnerEnv= entries from base before appending the word, as ProcessFixture.Env does.
findings.relation: contract: the environment carrier matches testutil.ProcessFixture.Env (brief section 6)
